statements.t: “As we approach year end, I’m proud of the progress we’ve made across our portfolio and the strong foundation we’ve built for what we expect to be a transformational 2027, with data anticipated across all three of our programs,” said Lyn Baranowski, Chief Executive Officer of Avalyn.

“We remain confident in the potential of inhaled therapies to transform the standard of care for pulmonary fibrosis by delivering effective, well-tolerated treatments both as monotherapies and in combination.
